summary.text: Hannah Kane is a Republican state representative from the 11th Worcester District who has held the seat since April 8, 2015 and is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Hannah Kane assumed office on April 8, 2015.

In the 2025-2026 session Ballotpedia lists her as the ranking minority member of the House Ethics Committee and of the Health Care Financing, Public Health, and State Administration and Regulatory Oversight joint committees, and as a member of the Steering, Policy and Scheduling Committee.

sources.title: Massachusetts House of Representatives elections, 2026 - Ballotpedia
